file_insights.purpose: Verification script for Redis connectivity and Django cache operations
key_components: Django environment setup with os.environ and django.setup()
Redis connection test using cache.set/get operations
Cache operations test with multiple data types (string, number, list, dict)
Cache key generation verification with KEY_PREFIX validation
Error handling with custom RuntimeError and ValueError exceptions

patterns_discovered.description: Script initializes Django environment before importing Django modules
patterns_discovered.benefit: Allows standalone script execution without manage.py context

patterns_discovered.description: Modular test functions with single responsibility principle
patterns_discovered.benefit: Clear separation of concerns, easy to debug individual failures

patterns_discovered.description: Try-except blocks with re-raised custom exceptions
patterns_discovered.implementation: Catches generic Exception, wraps in RuntimeError with context
patterns_discovered.benefit: Preserves original error information while adding context
Fails fast if cache is misconfigured rather than at runtime

gotchas_discovered.description: Django environment must be configured before importing cache module
gotchas_discovered.impact: Script will fail with ImportError or AttributeError if django.setup() is skipped
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Setup code placed at module top-level before any Django imports

gotchas_discovered.description: Backend validation uses exact string match 'django_redis.cache.RedisCache'
gotchas_discovered.impact: Will fail if different Redis cache backend is configured (e.g., different implementation)
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Consider using string containment or multiple valid backends if flexibility needed

gotchas_discovered.description: Django cache.get() returns None for missing/expired keys without raising exceptions
gotchas_discovered.impact: Tests rely on explicit value comparison rather than exception handling
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Script validates returned values match expected data rather than checking for None

gotchas_discovered.description: All cache operations set timeout=10 seconds
gotchas_discovered.impact: Tests may be flaky if test suite takes longer than timeout
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Timeout is reasonable for verification script but should be documented

approach_outcome.summary: Successfully created a comprehensive verification script for Redis cache connectivity
deliverables: Executable Python script with proper shebang
Three independent test functions covering connectivity, operations, and configuration
Exit code handling (0 for success, 1 for failure)
Informative error messages to stderr on failure

quality_metrics.documentation: Docstrings for all functions and module
quality_metrics.usability: Executable standalone script with clear success/failure output

recommendations.description: Test Redis connection pool status and available connections
Measure and report cache operation latency (set/get timing)
Support multiple Redis cache backend implementations instead of exact string match
Document why 10-second timeout was chosen for cache operations
Verify that cached values actually expire after timeout period
